title: Quadratic Hamilton maps and positive complex planes — restored proof edition
scope: Complete symplectic classification of real nonnegative and index-one quadratic forms, including all degenerate blocks; sectorial complex kernel and quotient geometry, strictly positive generalized spectral planes and numerical ranges, unique compatible structure, arbitrary-coordinate positive graphs and full non-strict reduction. Includes a complete finite spectral-algebra companion and fourteen unchanged solutions.
status: Reviewed restored lesson with exact current programme proofs
